title: HCP — Confirm or Reject Entry — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 Confirm or reject operation (HCP 3.8, 4.7.3, 5.4; `POST /v2/entries/{entryId}/confirmation` in HCP 9.2, 9.4.9): a Management Client, acting for the Context Subject, appends a confirmation record to an entry's current version. HCP defines no schema for this operation; the members come from HCP 9.2 and 9.4.9. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3. Every maxLength, maxItems and maxProperties in this schema is a Trust Tasks framework bound (SPEC §7.3 item 19), not an HCP requirement; so is every minLength or minItems of 1 on a member HCP's own schema allows to be empty.

entryId.description: HCP `entryId` (the `{entryId}` path parameter of HCP 9.2, 9.4.9): the entry's stable `id` (HCP 4.2), by which a Management Client names an entry (HCP 9.4.2).

disposition.description: HCP `disposition`: whether the Context Subject confirms or rejects the entry's current version (HCP 3.8, 9.4.9). HCP's own values, carried verbatim.

expectedVersion.description: HCP `expectedVersion`: the `record.version` the Management Client showed the Context Subject. Where it is not the entry's current version, the operation fails with version conflict and changes nothing (HCP 5.4, 5.5).

accessToken.description: The Management Client's HCP access token (HCP 9.3), carried unchanged. HCP's HTTP binding sends it as a Bearer token; this member carries it in the document. The provider validates it exactly as over HTTP and treats it as opaque. The maxLength is a framework bound, not an HCP requirement.

Response.title: HCP — Confirm or Reject Entry — response payload
Response.description: The entry, with the confirmation record appended to its current version and any status transition of HCP 4.7.3 applied (HCP 9.4.9). HCP's result body is the entry itself; the carriage wraps it in `entry`. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

entry.description: The HCP result (HCP 9.4.9): the whole entry, as a Management Client receives it (HCP 7.4), with the new record in `record.provenance.confirmations` (HCP 3.8).
